# 共同活动中的差别制造：多重决定下 but-for 与关系参与分离 / Difference-making in joint activity: but-for and relational participation come apart under overdetermination

## 主张 Claim

在一个依存可观测量的过程中，配置之间的维持与断裂沿运行恰是 Becoming.Dependence 的维持与断裂，两者互斥。but-for 检验留在过程之内：某步断裂依存，而扣除某一方的部分后由该配置出发的每一步都维持它，则这一方的部分造成了差别；扣除任何单独一方的部分仍有断裂之步，为多重决定，此时没有哪一方单独造成差别。在 Pool 中，同一过程、同一水平，第一个汲取者取同样的量：另有一方汲取时，它的部分造成差别；另有两方汲取时损失被多重决定，它的部分不造成差别，而扣除两方的部分则维持依存，差别由共同活动造成。两次运行中，关系读法都把它计为消耗，一个什么也不取的形成不计为消耗。一个形成的各事件之间也是如此：在公地过程中每步汲取两个单位，条件被消耗；第一个事件那一步维持依存，对任何周期都不侵蚀；扣除任何一个事件的汲取，条件仍被消耗。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / In a process with observables of dependence, keeping and breaking between configurations are, along a run, exactly those of Becoming.Dependence, and they are exclusive. The but-for test stays within the process: when a step breaks a dependence and, with one party's part withheld, every step from that configuration keeps it, that party's part makes the difference; when withholding any single party's part still leaves a breaking step, the loss is overdetermined and no party alone makes the difference. In Pool, in one process at one level with the first drawer taking the same amount: with one other drawer its part makes the difference; with two others the loss is overdetermined and its part makes none, while withholding two parts keeps the dependence, so the difference belongs to the joint activity. In both runs the relational reading counts it as consuming, and a formation that takes nothing is not. The same holds across a formation's own events: drawing two units at every step in the commons process consumes the condition; the first event's step keeps the dependence and undermines for no cycle; with any single event's draw withheld the condition is still consumed. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Joint.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joint.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 扣除（withhold）是外给的配置变换：只改动一方或一步的部分，过程本身给出由此到达的配置。扣除是否让其余不变，是每次应用的建模义务。 / Withholding is a supplied map on configurations: it changes only one party's or one step's part, and the process gives the configurations reached from there. Whether withholding leaves the rest unchanged is a modelling duty of each application.
- 关系读法是 relational-reading-comparison 的整段读法，经 Web.ConsumingIn 读出。 / The relational reading is the whole-run reading of relational-reading-comparison, read through Web.ConsumingIn.

but-for 检验与关系读法回答不同的问题：前者问扣除一方的部分是否改变结果，后者问一方实际参与了什么及该条件的去向。多重决定的情形正是“我的一份无关紧要”这一推理的形式。两者都不是因果理论，也不推出责任或义务。关于集体伤害与过度决定的哲学讨论（如 Parfit、Kagan，作者据先前知识，本次未新读）是对照。 / The but-for test and the relational reading answer different questions: whether withholding a party's part changes the outcome, and what a party actually took part in and where the condition went. The overdetermined case is the form of “my share makes no difference”. Neither is a causal theory, and neither yields responsibility or duty. Philosophical work on collective harm and overdetermination (for example Parfit and Kagan, from the author's prior knowledge, not newly read) is the comparison.
